answer: A basalt is one false identity. The cipher is the register of identities, mirrored in seven branches; a row goes live only when every branch attests the same key. Attestation burns nadir equal to the square of the rows that branch has already attested, so the thousandth basalt costs a million nadir per branch where the first costs one, and each branch must attest every clone, so splitting the fleet buys no discount. It breaks if one owner runs the branches, or if a new branch can be admitted and counted.
